## The decode's asks (prereg §5.3)

A re-ask is an ask inside an epoch that is already open. "Changed" is the share of re-asks, with the option applied last still on the menu, at which another option was applied: for a held arm, the share of held draws overturned. "Re-rolled" must be 0 for a held arm: a change at a re-ask to an option that was on the previous menu while the model's odds had not moved its way.
